Compression Ratio of Texture Memory Read.Description: Ratio of compressed to uncompressed color and depth texture memory read. Indicates the memory bandwidth savings achieved from texture compression. It compares the original (uncompressed) data size to the actual (compressed) size read from memory. A value of 2.0, for instance, signifies a 2:1 compression ratio, meaning the memory transfer was half the original size. Values below 1.0 indicate that compression was counter-productive, leading to wasted bandwidth.

Compression Ratio of Texture Memory Read.Description: Ratio of compressed to uncompressed color and depth texture memory read. Indicates the memory bandwidth savings achieved from texture compression. It compares the original (uncompressed) data size to the actual (compressed) size read from memory. A value of 2.0, for instance, signifies a 2:1 compression ratio, meaning the memory transfer was half the original size. Values below 1.0 indicate that compression was counter-productive, leading to wasted bandwidth.
Compression Ratio of Texture Memory Read.Name: Compression Ratio of Texture Memory Read
